```plato

// A playable range of frames under a fixed frame rate: the in point is shown
// first and the out point is exclusive. Both frame times carry Rate.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frame_rate)
type FrameSequence
    implements IValue
{
    Rate: FrameRate;
    InPoint: FrameTime;
    OutPoint: FrameTime;
}
```
